steps.title: P5-1 landform look: the Valley
steps.intro: Produced by tools/render_jobs/jobs/landform_look.json at 1920x1080. Five new 150 ft maps opened with the Valley landform through NewMap.create (probes/landform.gd new, the spec's landform through AuthoringController): temperate forest with seeds 1234 (a dry draw with a gravel wash), 2 (a river alone), 3 (a river with a ford) and 4 (a river with a tributary), and rocky badlands with seed 1234 (the same dry frame, a gravel_sandstone wash), each saved as _p5_valley_<biome>_<seed>. Per level: home with the grid, home with the water hidden, zoom 8 on the stage (the glade centre on the bend's inner bank) and zoom 8 on the river's middle (the floor when dry). Then seed 3 is played and a token dropped on its ford. Judge: does the trough read as one bold landform from the home camera (2.5 m deep, a third of the map wide, bent once, the rim at the base height); does the river sit in the floor with reaches and riffles and run off both edges; does the dry valley stand on its own as a place; is the glade open on the inner bank with the groves toward the edges; does the ford read and carry the token. Reports (the recipe's draw per seed) are in log.txt (landform.gd new / report).
